summary: fix(admin-panel): match relying party filter ignoring case and spaces
description:
## Because

- The relying party filter in the admin panel compared the text with a case-sensitive `indexOf`. Typing `send` did not find `Send`.
- The filter trimmed the input only for the empty check. Input with spaces around it matched nothing.

## This pull request

- Changes `getFilteredRps` in `PageRelyingParties/index.tsx` to trim and lowercase the filter text.
- Matches the text with `includes` against the lowercased name and the lowercased ID.
- Adds a test in `index.test.tsx`, `filters relying parties ignoring case and surrounding spaces`. It types `  firefox SEND `, clicks Filter, then clears the input and types an upper-cased ID.
- Removes the words "case-sensitive includes" from a comment in the existing name and ID filter test, because they are no longer true.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Closes:
